context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 30 tested session hardening, data export, input validation, and app versioning features. All features working: (1) GET /api/v1/app/version returns version 0.2.0, build_date, min_supported_version. (2) Login returns both access_token and refresh_token. (3) Token refresh works with valid refresh_token, returns 401 for invalid/expired tokens. (4) Data export returns all user data excluding password_hash, _id, and demo data. (7) HTML tags stripped from user input via sanitize_user_input. (8) Frontend stores refresh token in localStorage as t2t_refresh. (9) Version v0.2.0 displayed in legal footer. (10) Register page consent checkboxes control button enabled state. (11) Legal pages accessible without auth. (12) Multi-tab detection via localStorage events implemented in AuthContext.
